_readme: What each shelf book IS, in the controlled vocabulary of tools/similarity-prompt.md: weight 3 defining, 2 clearly present, 1 minor. Written by tools/similarity.py merge from agent output; book-similarity.json is built from it. A description, never a judgement - nothing here may feed an estimate.
_id: c:<book-cache.json key> for a candidate, r:<slug of the books-read.md title> for a read book - the same slug as book-media.json readMedia. A logged candidate changes id, so it is profiled again; its old line is pruned as an orphan.
_vd: Digest of the vocabulary's tag ids when the profile was made. An older vd still builds - unknown tags are dropped - but `status` counts it, because it never had the chance to use a tag added since.
